scope: Fifty-one audited second-conjugation third-person-plural forms ending in bare -e, all in papers 1-43.
choice: Add required final t at the exact reviewed lines: tvore to tvoret, zavise to zaviset, vhode to vhodet, and vode to vodet.
motivation: Official second-conjugation morphology requires third-person-plural -et. All mapped clauses have overt plural subjects or antecedents; nearby bare -e forms with singular subjects are explicitly outside this tranche.
alternatives_rejected: Append t to every bare -e verb: many are valid third-person singular or need separate context adjudication.
Retain these forms as number-neutral: this conflicts with the official paradigm and their explicit plural syntax.
Recast sentences lexically: unnecessary for a precise inflectional repair.

evidence.context_review: All 51 target sentences have plural subjects; mixed leže and other bare -e families were excluded for separate adjudication.

validation.structure: TeX controls, labels/references/citations, braces, math delimiters, protected fragments, and line counts unchanged
validation.reproducibility: Frozen output hashes reproduced immediately before atomic apply
